name: Eliphelet
overview: Eliphelet was a male descendant of the tribe of Judah, known as a son of King David. He is mentioned in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles, where he appears as one of David's sons. This Eliphelet is distinct from another son of David who shared the same name. He is also referred to as Elpelet in some passages, indicating a variant form of his name.
namesAndTitles: The name Eliphelet means 'G-d is my deliverance,' reflecting a profound trust in divine salvation. The variant Elpelet carries a similar meaning, 'G-d is deliverance,' emphasizing the same theological truth. Both names highlight the central biblical theme of God as the source of deliverance and help.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Eliphelet as a son of David, placing him within the royal lineage of Judah. Beyond this father-son relationship, no additional family connections are recorded in the provided information.
scriptureSignificance: Eliphelet's significance lies primarily in his inclusion among David's sons, affirming the continuation of the Davidic line through the tribe of Judah. His mention in the genealogical records helps establish the historical and theological foundation for the Davidic covenant, which ultimately points forward to the Messiah, Jesus Christ. The variant spelling of his name underscores the consistency of God's deliverance throughout David's family line.
